faq_heading: Price Reduced Homes for Sale in Maple Ridge: your questions answered

faq.q: How much below asking are homes selling for in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: SnapStats puts October 2026 at 96% of list price for Maple Ridge detached homes (4% below) and 97% for condos and townhomes (3% below).

faq.q: Is Maple Ridge a buyer's market or a seller's market?
faq.a: By the SnapStats reading, October 2026 was a balanced market for detached homes (15% sales ratio) and a balanced market for condos and townhomes (17%). Ratios below 12% favour buyers, those from 12% to 20% are balanced, and anything higher favours sellers.

faq.q: How long do Maple Ridge homes take to sell?
faq.a: The typical Maple Ridge detached home took 33 days to sell in October 2026, and a condo or townhome 32 days.

faq.q: Which price range has the most unsold detached homes in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 103 detached homes for sale and 21 sold in October 2026.

blocks.text: This search lists Maple Ridge homes where the asking price has dropped by at least 1%, pulled live from the MLS®. Land and income properties are left out; houses, townhomes and condos are all included. To weigh a reduced price, start with how the surrounding market has been behaving. In October 2026 a typical Maple Ridge detached home sold for $1,152,500, took 33 days and closed at 96% of its list price, with 388 detached homes for sale and 59 sold in the month.
What a price drop means in Maple Ridge right now

Detached homes in Maple Ridge have been selling about 4% under list price, and condos and townhomes about 3% under. On the detached side the sales ratio was 15%, which SnapStats reads as a balanced market. For condos and townhomes it was 17%, also a balanced market. In practice a modest cut aligns a home with what buyers have recently paid; a steep cut points to an early price that did not hold, which your agent can confirm from the listing history.

Supply is the other half. At October's pace the 388 detached listings would take 6.6 months to sell, and the 268 condo and townhome listings 5.8 months. Against October 2025, detached listings are 14% fewer and detached sales 16% more, which is the backdrop for how many price changes you will see.
Maple Ridge detached homes by area: where buyers have room

The areas holding the most unsold detached homes are where you are most likely to see a reduced price. In October that was West Central (71 listings, 8% sales ratio), Silver Valley (46 listings, 11% sales ratio). The fastest-moving area was Cottonwood, at a 22% ratio on 10 sales, so cuts there tend to be small or short-lived.

blocks.text: Price ranges with the most unsold Maple Ridge detached homes

The busiest price range for listings was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 103 homes for sale and 21 sold. The slowest of the well-stocked ranges were $1,500,001 to $1,750,000 (39 for sale, 2 sold); $1,250,001 to $1,500,000 (91 for sale, 16 sold); $900,001 to $1,000,000 (46 for sale, 9 sold). Offers below asking are most common in ranges like these.

blocks.text: Condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge

Condos and townhomes sold at a median $521,000 in Maple Ridge, after 32 days. The most crowded price range was $400,001 to $500,000, with 72 for sale and 11 sold. By area, East Central had the most listings (106, 25 sold), then West Central (78, 9 sold).
